name: The First Night
about: The opening quest line for a new game: a whole first day on Earth (the Humming Oak: meeting the town, the oak's mystery, three clues and three glowing acorns, the ground by the oak cracking open at midnight), then the first Void day. scripts/first_night.gd and scripts/humming_oak.gd glue it to the rest of the game. Every step can be skipped from the quest log.

steps.text: It's a sunny morning in Stars Hollow, and someone's knocking! Say hi to Nina outside, then go and meet the town.
checklist: Talk to Nina, outside your house
Meet Mr. Palmer by the gazebo
Say hello to two more people round the green

steps.text: Nina wants to show you the notice board on the green, by the gazebo. People in Stars Hollow pin up jobs there, and they pay sparkles!
checklist: Read the notice board by the gazebo
Follow a job, to put a star on your map
Finish a job and turn it in at the board

steps.text: Nina says the old oak on the green hums every midnight. Go and listen to it.
Something's ticking inside the old oak! Find out what's going on before midnight.
checklist: Ask Mr. Page at Turn the Page (the bookshop) about the old oak
Look at the lilac envelope on Mr. Palmer's porch
Find 3 glowing acorns: Mossy Falls, the pumpkin patch, Lookout Hill

steps.text: The sun's going down. Put the three glowing acorns in the nook in the old oak's roots.
The runes on the old oak are glowing, and the hum keeps getting louder. Nina's sure it's all about midnight. Sleep in your bed "Until midnight" to get there quicker, or explore till then.
It's midnight! Go to the old oak.
The ground in front of the old oak has cracked open, and it glows! Jump in, and see where it takes you. (Then look for someone waving a clipboard.)
A whole day in the Void! Tally says Rex is at the Skate Park, and the Gloops round the Market need popping.
checklist: Finish a request from Tally's board
Skate Park: push along with Rex, Rook and Coach Bruno
Find the lost watch on the Market fountain

steps.text: What a day! Enjoy the Void while it lasts. Your new watch seems to be counting something down... (Then find Nina.)

reward.message: That was the first night of many. The portal opens again every midnight. (+10 sparkles)
